metadata.command:
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path("downloads");
print("\n".join(sorted(f.name for f in p.iterdir() if f.is_file())))'
perl -MDigest::SHA=sha256_hex -e 'for (@ARGV){open F,"<",$_ or die; binmode F; local $/; $b=<F>; printf "%s %s\n", substr(sha256_hex($b),0,12), $_;}' downloads/*

cmp "downloads/budget v2.csv" "downloads/budget_v2 (copy).csv"; echo budget:$?; cmp "downloads/Invoice (1).txt" "downloads/invoice-final FINAL.txt"; echo inv:$?; cmp "downloads/Meeting_Notes_Oct.md" "downloads/meeting notes oct.md"; echo meet:$?
